name: quadrant
source:
One summer day, sisters Lyder and Iris received a letter from their uncle who invited them to visit a remote castle that he had bought. The sisters accepted the invitation, but their uncle was not there, so they decided to wait for his return.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-july-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一個夏日，姊妹莉德和艾瑞絲收到了叔叔的來信，邀請她們去參觀他購買的一座偏遠城堡。姊妹倆接受了邀請，但叔叔並不在那裡，於是她們決定等待他的歸來。

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-july-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]］
